entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. It's just... not good. It's surprisingly hard to use.

I'm sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. I see here that you received it 12 days ago. Could you tell me a bit more about what you're finding confusing? Sometimes new devices can have a bit of a learning curve.
I suppose. I just expected more from it. I can't find the detailed workout summaries it's supposed to have. The screen just shows the time and my heart rate.
Ah, I think I understand. Did you get a chance to look through the user manual for the workout modes?
Yes, I glanced at the user manual. It wasn't helpful. For this price, it should be obvious.

I can definitely appreciate that. To save battery, the detailed stats don't live on the band's main screen. You actually access them by double-tapping the side button to enter the 'Exercise' menu. From there, you can swipe to see your recent activities with all the data. Have you tried that?
No. Nobody said to do that. Hold on.
Take your time.
Fine. I see it now. My run from yesterday is here.
Great! And if you sync it with the VeloFit app on your phone, you'll get even more detailed charts and GPS maps from your workouts. Is that more in line with what you were looking for?
Whatever. I guess this is what I wanted. It shouldn't be that hidden.

That's very fair feedback, and I'll pass it along to our design team. I'm glad we were able to find the feature for you. Since we've located the functions you were looking for, do you still wish to proceed with a return?
No, I'll keep it. It's fine.
Wonderful. I'm happy I could help clarify that. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and I hope you enjoy your VeloBand Pulse. Have a great rest of your day.
